GUESTS DIFFERENT FACTS. 80 A FIX THAT CANNOT BE SWITCHED OFF AGAIN IS A FIX YOU CANNOT ATTRIBUTE.
**⚠ 81 (w19) A DIMENSION THE ENGINE NEVER READS IS A DIMENSION THAT CANNOT PROTECT YOU.** `GenStep_Scatterer.CountFromPer10kCells` squares `map.Size.x` and never touches `Size.z` or `map.Area`. Every banded map has therefore been issued exactly ONE band's worth of geysers/chunks/vents and spraying it over seven. Before assuming a count scales with area, READ THE ARITHMETIC — half of §99 was already latent in the ground level and nobody had reported it because there was nothing to compare against.
**⚠ 82 (w19) TO INHERIT A MOD'S CONTENT, RUN ITS CODE, NOT ITS DEFS.** ReGrowth 2's boulders have no def and no genstep of their own — they are a TRANSPILER on vanilla's `GenStep_RockChunks`. Any "re-run generation for X" feature must re-run the real genstep under a redirect, because a name-based or def-based reimplementation cannot see IL that another mod injected.
**⚠ 83 (w19) LIE ABOUT THE MAP AT THE THREE CELL FUNNELS, NOT AT THE CALLERS.** `Map.AllCells`, `cellsInRandomOrder.GetAll()` and `GenStep_Scatterer.TryFindScatterCell` are where essentially every genstep — vanilla, DLC and modded, present and future — asks "where may I put things". Redirecting those three at one rect makes foreign generation code band-aware for free.

# 96. WATER RENDER PARITY — **SHIPPED w18; ⚠⚠ WORKS, MECHANISM UNATTRIBUTED**

**96.a PIPELINE:** `WaterInfo.SetTextures` runs per frame from `Map.MapUpdate` and publishes `_WaterOutputTex`, `_WaterReflectionTex`, camera params, `_WaterOffsetTex`, and as its LAST statement `_MapSize` = (x, z). Compiled shader unreadable.
**96.b THE SHIPPED FIX (`ABWaterMapSize.cs`):** on banded maps only, republish `_MapSize` as (x, bandHeight). Reads real `bandHeight`. Stands down while the lab drives. Dev toggle: `AB2: water - toggle SHIPPED band _MapSize fix`.
**96.c DELIVERY — SETTLED BY MEASUREMENT (#509):** `0 of 6 water depth material(s) declare _MapSize`. Material-local shadowing was NEVER possible. Global is the only delivery that can work, and it is inherently water-scoped (`_MapSize` written in EXACTLY ONE place in vanilla).
**96.d MECHANISM (plausible, not proven):** shader UVs surface by `worldPos.xz / _MapSize`; (126, 896) divides z seven times harder than x.
**96.e ⚠⚠ WHAT #509 DID AND DID NOT ESTABLISH.** With the fix ON the water looked correct. With it OFF the streaking did NOT return — the A/B did not discriminate. Three live possibilities: (A) `_MapSize` is not the cause and something else in w18 fixed it (most likely §56n/§56r or `ABWaterBand.ToSurfaceBand`); (B) the toggle did not take (untested); (C) the tile (ocean) never reproduced a symptom first reported on a LAKE. **USER CLOSED THE INVESTIGATION ON "it works fine" (rule 7).** **⚠ THE 30-SECOND PROTOCOL:** `paint test pond` → `report+` (expect `(126,126)`) → toggle OFF → `report+` (expect `(126,896)`) → look again. Rule 80. **⚠ RELEASE NOTES: do not claim this as a water fix with a mechanism.**

**98.a THE AUDIT.** 135 files / 50,336 lines / 357 types / 1,236 methods. 12 dead methods; 28 clone pairs; 16 cache-hostile loops; 54 silent catches of 303; 5 targets patched by 2+ of our own classes. ⚠ Pass-3 reachability OVER-REPORTS.

**98.d VERIFICATION (#508).** `context=SURFACE(15876 cells borrowed)`; authored cells 1,893 → 7,159; no leak. ⚠ "anchor water == surface water" is NOT the criterion. ⚠ Previews author MORE than the colony and that is CORRECT (rule 79).

# 99. BAND DRESSING — EVERY LEVEL IS A REAL LEVEL — **BUILT w19, ⚠⚠ ENTIRELY UNTESTED**

**99.a THE REPORT (user, w19).** "Upper bands (and lower) devoid of rock chunks, vegetation (too sparse for biome) and features (lakes, vents, etc) including Odyssey landmarks and Vanilla Landmarks Expanded. Steam Geysers, Helixian Gas Vents, and Boulders from Regrowth 2. Anima trees should be level bounded to the ground level, and ancient wreckage, including from mods like Vanilla Vehicles Expanded and Vehicle Framework or the vanilla Mechanitor should never spawn in lower levels." **User rulings when asked:** flora = vanilla's own pass, mod-aware, PARITY (i.e. drop the alpine rim curve); features = GENERALISE (auto-detect + blocklist, not a whitelist); landmarks = OPTION B (whitelist the safe mutator families); wreckage = **ground level only, ALL other bands**, and specifically the PROPS + mechanitor wreckage, not the broad ruins/slag category.

**99.b THE DIAGNOSIS — THREE CAUSES, ONE ROOT.**
1. **THE CARVE IS TOTAL AND RUNS LAST.** Every genstep generates across the whole 126×896 map (SteamGeysers 950, RockChunks 970, mod vents/boulders alongside), then our `GenerateContentsIntoMap` postfix erases every non-surface band and rebuilds it. Nothing re-placed what it erased. Band content was only ever ABSkyBandGen's tarns/scree/flora and ABCavernGen's flora/ore/fauna.
2. **THE INITIAL PLANT PASS WAS DELIBERATELY SUPPRESSED** on doomed bands (`Patch_WildPlantSpawner_ABSkipDoomedBands`, a correct perf fix). Band flora was therefore our constants only: sky `0.16 × plantDensity` thinned as far as ×0.30 by the alpine rim curve; cavern `0.08 × plantDensity`. "Too sparse for biome" is an exact description of the cause.
3. **⚠⚠ AND THE GROUND LEVEL WAS SHORT TOO — UNREPORTED, INVISIBLE, LATENT SINCE V2 BEGAN.** `CountFromPer10kCells` squares `map.Size.x` and NEVER reads `Size.z` or `map.Area`, so a 126×896 map is issued the count a 126×126 map gets — one band's worth — which vanilla then sprays over seven bands. The surface has been getting ≈1/7 of its correct geyser/chunk/vent count, with the other 6/7 generated straight into the carve's path. **Rule 81.**

**99.c THE MECHANISM — `ABBandScope` (new file).** Rather than reimplementing gensteps band-aware (which cannot work — rule 82), lie to them about the map at **three cell funnels (rule 83)**: `Map.AllCells` (prefix, returns the band `CellRect`), `MapCellsInRandomOrder.GetAll` (postfix, band-filtered shuffled list), `GenStep_Scatterer.TryFindScatterCell` (prefix, samples the band rect and calls the instance's OWN `CanScatterAt` virtually via cached `MethodInfo.Invoke` — rule 36). The veto half lives INSIDE `Patch_GenStep_Scatterer_ABBandSeam` in ABBandSafety, not in a second postfix on the same target (rule 50). Single-slot not a stack; nested `Push` is a hard error; `AssertNoneOutstanding` shouts on a leak (rule 15). `Active` is a plain static bool so the unarmed cost is one load. `rejectOpenAir` is set for SKY bands so a foreign genstep is never offered a void cell (rule 14). **Sweep budget:** the exhaustive fallback sweep is capped at 2 per `Generate` call, because `CanScatterAt` only ever gets more restrictive as `usedSpots` grows, and 2 is exactly the number of distinct predicates a scatterer can present (normal + `useFallback`) — rule 74.

**99.d WHAT SHIPPED IN TIER 1.**
- **`ABBandDressing.Dress`** — called from the tail of `CarveInner`, after `CarveGutters` (gutters exist, so nothing can straddle a seam) and BEFORE the basement refog (cave dressing stays hidden until mined). **⚠ It runs under `CarveInProgress`, which is not incidental: `ABAirSpawnGuard` would otherwise walk every geyser we place back onto the surface, exactly as it walked 18,075 basement rocks upstairs at run #46 (§57).**
- **Genstep capture** — a Prefix on `GenerateContentsIntoMap` records the `IEnumerable<GenStepWithParams>` ARGUMENT, i.e. exactly what ran including mutator/DLC/mod injections. Deliberately not `MapGeneratorDef.genSteps` (rule 62).
- **Eligibility (capability → shape → names, in that order).** Include `GenStep_RockChunks` (which is BOTH vanilla loose rock AND ReGrowth 2's boulders, via their transpiler) and any `GenStep_Scatterer` that is not `isJunk`, not `nearPlayerStart`/`nearMapCenter`, and whose type name / defName misses the blocklist fragments (ruins, shrines, monoliths, clusters, quests, mineable lumps, wreck/junk/ancient, prefab structures, anima/polux/exostrider/tunneler/vehicle/crash/ship/quarry/ore).
- **Per-band reseed** — `Rand.Seed = HashCombine(tile, def.index, band*7919)` so levels do not all get an identical scatter.
- **Flora parity** — vanilla's `CheckSpawnWildPlantAt` over each band rect with `CurrentPlantDensityFactor` and `CurrentWholeMapNumDesiredPlants`, plus vanilla's own 0.001 skip. **⚠ Both figures are read OUTSIDE every scope**, because `CurrentWholeMapNumDesiredPlants` walks `map.AllCells` and a scoped read would return one band's demand and saturate every band at a seventh of the right density. **⚠ NO BAND SCOPE IS ARMED DURING THE FLORA PASS** for the same reason. Composes with existing seeders: `CheckSpawnWildPlantAt` refuses cells that already hold a plant, so ABCavernGen's characterful cave flora survives untouched and vanilla tops it up; **ABSkyBandGen's `SeedFlora` now stands down entirely (dropping the alpine rim curve = the requested parity) and registers itself as a zero-yield FALLBACK** (rule 33).
- **`Patch_GenStep_ABSurfaceBandScope`** — confines the ORIGINAL generation-time `GenStep_Scatterer.Generate` / `GenStep_RockChunks.Generate` to the surface band. Fixes 99.b(3) AND deletes the wasted carve-fodder spawns. ⚠ Subclasses that override `Generate` without calling base are NOT covered — deliberate: failure mode is "no improvement", never "new breakage".
- **`ABGroundOnly`** — anima and every other special tree pinned to the surface band via a postfix on `GenStep_SpecialTrees.CanSpawnAt`, the one predicate BOTH the genstep and `IncidentWorker_AnimaTreeSpawn` funnel through. **⚠ The incident path was covered by nothing at all before now** — the carve only ever caught the generation-time half. Wreckage is enforced at the genstep level (`isJunk`) plus ABAirSpawnGuard's pre-existing decoration window (which already pins VEF `ObjectSpawnsDef` content — VVE/Vehicle Framework wrecks — to the surface); the new `AuditBands` census is an ASSERTION not a cleanup, because wreckage reaching a band would mean a FOURTH placement path exists and the right response is to find it (rule 65).
- **Settings:** `bandFeatures` (default true), `bandVegetationParity` (default true). `skyVegetationDensity` keeps its meaning — it now scales vanilla's density factor instead of our constant, so 1.0 is true parity.

**99.e ⚠⚠ THE TWO REGRESSION RISKS, NAMED IN ADVANCE.**
1. **`Map.AllCells` is a very broad patch target.** Guarded by a static bool + reference compare and only ever armed inside the carve, but a leak would silently confine ordinary play to one rect. `AssertNoneOutstanding` exists for exactly this; watch for its error text.
2. **`Patch_GenStep_ABSurfaceBandScope` CHANGES GROUND-LEVEL GENERATION for the first time in this mod's life.** Expect the surface to have visibly MORE geysers/chunks/ruins than every previous build — that is the fix, not a bug (it is the count a 126×126 unbanded colony always got). But it also means ~7× the ruins/shrines per surface band, so watch `ABStructureFit` for new straddler rescues and watch generation time.
3. Secondary: generation cost. `Dress` calls `TryRebuildDirtyRegionsAndRooms` once and then re-runs N gensteps × M bands plus a full plant pass per band. **Measure `BandDressing band N` against the carve's 3.9–5.3 s (ledger 10).**

**99.f TIER 2 — LANDMARKS / TILE MUTATORS (OPTION B), NOT STARTED.** Odyssey landmarks and Vanilla Landmarks Expanded are `LandmarkDef` → `TileMutatorDef` → `TileMutatorWorker`, NOT scatterers, so nothing in Tier 1 touches them; and `ABBandLocal` currently pins the ones we patch (Coast/River/Lake, VEE LoneIsland/Crater families) to the SURFACE band on purpose. The plan: whitelist the band-safe families (hot springs / geyser fields, plant groves, rocky-boulder, animal habitat, mixed biome) and re-run `GenStep_MutatorPostTerrain` / `MutatorFinal` under a band scope with the mutator list filtered to the whitelist. **⚠ The excluded families are excluded for real reasons: a Coast or River mutator on a sky plateau means deep water lipping over a three-level drop, and crater mutators punch through band walls.** ⚠ Re-running the mutator gensteps also re-enters `TileMutatorWorker_Landform`, which §56r patches heavily — the context-borrow interaction must be reasoned about before any code is written. Do NOT start before Tier 1 is field-verified (rule 49).
